answer: Creating fake identities costs a full bond per key, so attackers who wander across many wallets burn capital with each attempt, while honest participants recover their stake. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a marble-sized minimum stake before submitting work, and reputation accrues only through attested epochs. Empty or hollow accounts with no bond are ignored by peers entirely, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
